research_team.name: Pune East Real Estate Research & Advisory Team
research_team.description: Specialized real estate market intelligence, MahaRERA compliance auditing, and property valuation advisory team covering Pune East micro-markets (Manjari, Hadapsar Annexe, Kharadi, Magarpatta, and Solapur Road).

methodology.price_verification: Quarterly aggregation of prevailing developer cost sheets, ready reckoner rates, and recorded registry trends.
methodology.rera_verification: Direct cross-referencing with the official Maharashtra Real Estate Regulatory Authority portal (maharera.maharashtra.gov.in).
methodology.connectivity_audit: Standard GPS-calculated arterial driving distances and public transit corridor timelines under typical traffic conditions.
